title: feat(text): place typed text in a TrueType outline font as closed shapes
body:
## What changed

- New module `camcraft_geometry::outline_text`. It reads a TrueType outline font and makes a typed string into closed shapes, in mm, on the layer `text`.
  - `ttf.rs` is our own reader, written from the public OpenType specification. It reads `cmap` formats 4 and 12, `loca`, `glyf` (simple and composite glyphs), `hmtx`, `hhea`, `maxp`, `head` and the `OS/2` cap height. Each read has a bounds check.
  - `mod.rs` flattens the quadratic contours to lines, with a chord error of 0.005 mm or less. It then makes a `SketchData` with closed chains only.
  - `sample_font.rs` makes a small test font in memory. It has our own glyphs, so the repository stores no font file.
- New undoable command `InsertOutlineText` (`crates/app/src/commands/insert_outline_text.rs`). It reads the font once at construction. The profile keeps the shapes, not the font, so the project file format does not change.
- New MCP tool `insert_outline_text` (`crates/app/src/mcp/outline_text_tools.rs`). The tool is also in `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` (generated) and in the MCP guide table.
- These inputs are refused by name:
  - a font that cannot be read, a CFF font (`.otf` with PostScript outlines) or a font collection;
  - an empty text, or a character that the font does not have;
  - outlines that cross or touch;
  - a nested outline that runs in the same direction as the outline around it (`OutlineTextError::Winding`);
  - a height or a spacing outside the limits;
  - a setup that does not exist, a setup with no stock, or a name that is in use.
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/3072-outline-text.md`.

## Cause

This is a new feature (#3072). Before this PR, typed text was only single-stroke engraving text (`insert_text`, #2679).

## Review fixes

Round 1:

- Large curves keep the 0.005 mm chord tolerance. A curve can use up to 4096 pieces. A curve that needs more is refused.
- Composite glyphs apply `SCALED_COMPONENT_OFFSET`. A component with both offset flags is refused.
- Table reads use each declared table boundary. Character maps also use each declared subtable boundary.

Round 2:

- Nonzero winding fill. The sketch reads holes by nesting, but a TrueType font fills by the nonzero winding rule. These two readings agree only when each outline runs opposite to the innermost outline around it. `check_winding` in `outline_text/mod.rs` refuses all other arrangements by name. Thus a same-direction inner contour is never made a hole.
- Red verification result. The branch was 106 commits behind `upstream/main`. On the old base, `blind_slot`, `corner_relief_safety` and one post-dialog UI test failed. The trial merge of the reviewer passed them. I merged `upstream/main` into the branch with a merge commit (no rebase, no conflicts). The earlier author run reported a working graphics adapter and a green quick gate on its then-current head. The current round results are below.

Round 3:

- Merged current `upstream/main` `edcbfe4dd678da799d1102cd8324403afaa5c344` with a clean merge commit.
- The GPU bounds loop now iterates over dimensions. This clears the reported upstream `needless_range_loop` warning and preserves every bounds check.
- No UI test was changed or disabled. The current sandbox run cannot find a Metal graphics adapter. No software fallback is available in this build.

## Tests

- Geometry `outline_text`: 10 passed, 0 failed on the final head.
- App `insert_outline_text`: 4 passed, 0 failed on the final head.
- Pin proof, round 2: `nested_outlines_follow_the_nonzero_winding_fill`. With the `check_winding` call removed, the test failed at `crates/geometry/tests/outline_text.rs:233` (the same-direction `O` was accepted). With the call restored, it passed. The test also checks that an `O` with both directions swapped still has one hole, and that `II` stays two shapes.
- Pin proof, round 1: the four round-1 tests failed with the original reviewed source and passed with the fixes:
  - `large_curves_measure_inside_the_chord_tolerance`
  - `composite_offsets_use_the_component_transform`
  - `declared_table_lengths_bound_reads_with_trailing_bytes`
  - `declared_cmap_subtable_lengths_bound_reads`

- Pin proof, round 3: `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-gpu --all-targets -- -D warnings`, with rustc 1.99.1. Restoring the original range loop in the source produced **RED** at `crates/gpu/src/cut.rs:126`. Restoring the fixed dimension iterator in the source produced **GREEN**. The lint command pins this mechanical change.

Final head: `4cc0638eee9155b2cdac957685a0014898caeff3`.
Quick-gate base at start: `upstream/main` `edcbfe4dd678da799d1102cd8324403afaa5c344` (merged into this head).

The shared `upstream/main` reference advanced without our fetch to `b5ef7c39e9504ec67dca67f7727b916550d639d1` before the heavy run. The merge base remains `edcbfe4dd678da799d1102cd8324403afaa5c344`. The tested tree and head did not change during verification. The heavy command uses `--base upstream/main`; its result is below.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **RED**. 1132 steps: 1128 passed, 4 failed, 0 stalled. Wall time: 43.3 minutes.
  - `ui suites: lib`: 1473 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored.
  - `ui suites: egui_app`: 5 passed, 3 failed.
  - `ui suites: shell`: 20 passed, 1 failed.
  - The UI failures report no Metal adapter in this sandbox. This build has no software fallback. Review finding 1 remains unresolved.
  - `app suites: mcp_setup_moves`: `move_an_operation_delete_the_emptied_setup_and_undo_redo_both` failed at line 98. Undo restores setup order as `Front, Back`; the test expects `Back, Front`. This failure is outside the latest review findings. The test and related setup, move and delete command files are identical to upstream. They remain unchanged. No separate upstream baseline run was made.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: **GREEN**. All 251 steps passed. There were 0 failed and 0 stalled steps. Wall time: 31.1 minutes. All four known-fail checks gave the expected results.
- Full gate clippy: **GREEN**. All nine selected crates passed, including GPU, UI, app and geometry. Wall time: 78 seconds. The reported lint in review finding 2 is fixed. Its requirement for a green full quick gate remains unresolved.
- Touched-crate clippy: **GREEN** through the full gate clippy step. Its nine selected crates include every touched crate.
- Requested UI targets: **RED** on this final head, with the counts above. No UI test was disabled or removed.

## Goldens moved

None. These suites passed on the final head:

- `app suites: example_catalog`: 37 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `app suites: example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `app suites: example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `app suites: golden_cl`: 33 passed, 0 failed.

The golden files are unchanged, and the worktree is clean. No recorded program was regenerated or changed. The heavy run passed all four ignored catalog cases.

## Not exercised

- `graphify update`: the command is not installed on this host.
- UI screenshots: not applicable. This PR changes no UI code.
- Toolpath generation on the text. A toolpath from the chains of any DXF-type profile is not on main yet: #1867 does that work. The test only pins that the pocket and the contour accept the text as closed chains.
- A real third-party font file. The tests use the generated sample font only.
- CFF (`.otf` PostScript) fonts. These are refused by name. A CFF reader can come later as a different issue.
- Manual interactive UI use. Automated UI tests ran and failed as recorded above. This PR adds no dialog. The command is available through MCP.

## Overlaps

- #2924 changes `crates/app/src/mcp/sketch_tools.rs` (`insert_text`). This PR does not touch that file.
- #3304 changes `crates/app/src/commands/insert_text.rs`. This PR does not touch that file. It has its own name helper.
- These PRs touch `crates/geometry/src/lib.rs`: #3061, #2999, #2993, #2992, #2981, #2979, #2978 and #2924. Each adds a line to the module list, so the lines are different. The PR that merges second refreshes.

Changelog: Typed text in a TrueType outline font becomes a profile of closed shapes (letter holes included) for a pocket, V-carve or cut-out: MCP tool `insert_outline_text`, one undo step; unreadable or CFF fonts, missing glyphs, overlapping outlines and nested outlines that the font's nonzero fill does not make holes are refused by name.

Fixes #3072
